entities.name: Ángela Gurría
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángela Gurría Davó was a Mexican sculptor. In 1974, she became the first female member of the Academia de Artes. She is best known for her monumental sculptures such as Señal, an eighteen-meter tall work created for the 1968 Summer Olympics. She lived and worked in Mexico City.

entities.summary: Ángela Gurría Davó was a Mexican sculptor. In 1974, she became the first female member of the Academia de Artes. She is best known for her monumental sculptures such as Señal, an eighteen-meter tall work created for the 1968 Summer Olympics. She lived and worked in Mexico City.
